ITEM 1 | Cluster of cubed pieces in the lower-right corner of a square white plate, roughly 1.5 to 2.5 cm chunks with irregular edges; surfaces are orange-red to brown with darker caramelized patches and a glossy, slightly oily sheen; pieces look moist and hold their shape, some with a thin coating of reddish sauce; a few small green flecks visible; they sit clustered together covering about 12 percent of the plate's area and stand about 1 to 1.5 cm tall | 85

ITEM 2 | Reddish-orange sauce residue and crumbs scattered on the plate surface near the cluster, including about four small flecks roughly 0.3 to 0.5 cm across, matte to slightly glossy, soft and smeared rather than holding a shape, lying flat against the white plate | 3
